specs.name: isPalindrome_true_iff_eq_reverse
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = true → s.toList == s.toList.reverse

specs.name: isPalindrome_true_implies_list_eq_reverse
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = true → s.toList = s.toList.reverse

specs.name: isPalindrome_false_implies_ne_reverse
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = false → s.toList ≠ s.toList.reverse

specs.name: isPalindrome_false_implies_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = false → s.toList ≠ []

specs.name: isPalindrome_reverse_eq
specs.stmt: theorem isPalindrome_reverse_eq : ∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s) (h_precond2 : isPalindrome_precond (String.mk s.toList.reverse)), isPalindrome s h_precond = isPalindrome (String.mk s.toList.reverse) h_precond2

specs.name: isPalindrome_eq_list_beq_reverse
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = (s.toList == s.toList.reverse)

specs.name: isPalindrome_idempotent
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = isPalindrome s h_precond

specs.name: isPalindrome_of_reverse_palindrome
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s)
    (h_precond2 : isPalindrome_precond ⟨s.toList.reverse⟩),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = true →
    isPalindrome ⟨s.toList.reverse⟩ h_precond2 = true

specs.name: isPalindrome_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : String) (h : isPalindrome_precond args),
    isPalindrome_postcond args (isPalindrome args h) h

specs.name: isPalindrome_iff_eq_reverse
specs.stmt: isPalindrome s h = true ↔ s.data = s.data.reverse

specs.name: isPalindrome_of_reverse_palindrome
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    s.toList = s.toList.reverse → isPalindrome s h_precond = true

specs.name: isPalindrome_postcond_result_false
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isPalindrome_precond s),
    isPalindrome s h_precond = false →
    s.toList ≠ [] ∧ s.toList != s.toList.reverse
